source.citation: Chen, L.; Rivas, J.; Rangel, A. (2025), Advancing ECLSS Reliability Modeling: Integrating ISS Data for Sustainable Long-Duration Mission Planning, 54th International Conference on Environmental Systems, ICES-2025-127.
source.extraction_scope: Selected reference subset: 9 component entries from Appendix Tables 2–5 plus 2 Table 1 crew R&R task estimates. Supplementary register covers 133 further component entries and 39 further Table 1 crew R&R tasks.
limitations: Authors state the reliability dataset is not yet complete.
Authors state analogies may be used where required component data are unavailable.
Authors state the integrated simulation framework is still in development and planned for a future ICES paper.
Table 1 crew R&R estimates exclude gathering and stowing time.
Crew time depends on installation location, accessibility and task complexity; Table 1 is not exhaustive.
MTBF values are not standalone mission failure probabilities. The paper's annual failure-rate expression also depends on duty cycle, installed quantity and K-factor.
No raw MADS event history, censoring treatment, complete exposure denominators or independent calibration set is distributed in this source register.
Table 5 component R&R time is kept separate from Table 1 major-ORU crew R&R task time; the two are not interchangeable.

component_records.notes: Published component row. Do not infer mission reliability without duty cycle, quantity and model assumptions.
Published component row; MTTR is an operational reliability input, not the full crew task or mission downtime.
High published K-factor in the selected WPA sample; preserve source value and do not reinterpret it as a probability.
Table 3 operational MTTR is 7 h. The separate Table 1 UPA Distillation Assembly crew R&R estimate is 3 h (180 min) in crew_task_records.
Preventive-maintenance-limited row. MTBPMRR=60 days; MTTPMRR=0.17 h. Not a stochastic MTBF row.
Preventive-maintenance-limited row. MTBPMRR=545 days; MTTPMRR=0.17 h.
Table 5 reports component R&R=0.5 h; this is distinct from the Table 1 major-ORU crew R&R task estimates. Limited life: 6,750 lb throughput or four years wetted life.
Table 4 gives approximately 10.8 years operational life for the processor. Text section also describes the detrusor at approximately 10.8 years.

calendar_limited_life.unit: weeks maximum after brine fill before disposal

component_records.notes: Table 4 states that each bladder must be disposed of within 35 weeks of brine fill. The paper separately reports the BPA batch processes 24 L of brine every 26 days; this is a batch/cadence reference, not a throughput-limited lifetime or the bladder's instantaneous capacity.

crew_task_records.notes: Table 1 major ORU crew R&R estimate (14 h); excludes gathering/stowing and depends on installation access and task complexity.

crew_task_records.oru: WPA — Gas Separator, Water Delivery, Ion Exchange and AAA (combined task grouping)
crew_task_records.notes: Table 1 major ORU crew R&R estimate (19 h 15 min) for one combined task grouping; do not allocate this to each component individually; excludes gathering/stowing.
